title: Sweetwater Grade 1 lesson plan, week of Nov 2
scope: Excerpts only: lesson-content lines ClassThread items cite. No names, rosters, small-group links or student information.
content:
[Week of Nov 2 | Foundations 11/2, Wednesday (session 27)-Cumulative Review] Read and write words with -sh, -th, -ch, wh, -sh, -ck
[Week of Nov 2 | Foundations 11/2, Wednesday (session 27)-Cumulative Review] Read and understand words with ‘s
[Week of Nov 2 | Foundations 11/2, Thursday (session 28)-Cumulative Review] Red and write words that have words with ch, ng, and tch.
[Week of Nov 2 | Foundations 11/2, Thursday (session 28)-Cumulative Review] Read and write words that end in s and es.
[Week of Nov 2 | Foundations 11/2, Thursday (session 28)-Cumulative Review] Word Bank: bench, ring, patch
[Week of Nov 2 | Foundations 11/2, Friday (session 29-30)] Read and write words that have bl, cl, fl, pl at the beginning.
[Week of Nov 2 | Foundations 11/2, Friday (session 29-30)] Read and write words that have st, sk, sm, sp at the beginning of a word.
[Week of Nov 2 | Foundations 11/2, Vocabulary & Strategy] Superwords: like, make, there, what; go, no, so, which, from, have, look, or,about, out, play, were; by, come, my, some
[Week of Nov 2 | M 11/2, Lesson title] Unit 2 Review Week and Assessment
[Week of Nov 2 | M 11/2, Vocabulary & Strategy] Near Doubles: Adding two numbers that are 1 apart. (5 + 6 = 11)
[Week of Nov 2 | Science 11/2, Learning Target] make a chart to show different types of weather and describe how the weather changes over time.
[Week of Nov 2 | Science 11/2, Success Criteria] Record my weather symbol in a chart/graph.
